grades.reason: Describes a race example, not monitor mutual exclusion or condition waiting.

grades.quote: The lock can only be locked by one thread at a time.
grades.reason: Explains exclusive access and identifies monitors as a structured mutex interface, but omits condition waiting.

grades.quote: If more than one thread is trying to lock the same mutex, only one of them will switch the mutex from unlocked to locked; that thread will be allowed to proceed. The others will wait until the mutex is again unlocked.
grades.reason: Explains the mutual-exclusion component, but waiting for a mutex is not monitor condition waiting.

grades.quote: One, condition variables, is an important extension to monitors; the combination of monitors with condition variables allows many situations to be cleanly handled.
grades.reason: Connects monitors with mutual exclusion and condition variables, but does not explain how condition waiting coordinates with exclusive access.
